name: Word Storm
desc: A swarm of typographic particles that wanders a dark field and periodically coalesces to spell a word before scattering again, rendered as motion-streaked type, sumi ink, CMYK halftone, wireframe, RGB glitch or thermal false-color.

density.doc: swarm particle count (extra floaters beyond the word letters)

style.doc: rendering philosophy: streaked sans mass / brushed sumi on paper / CMYK misregister print / schematic outline / RGB-split datamosh / speed-mapped heat false-color

act.doc: dramaturgy: breathe between scatter and spelled word / never resolve (pure swarm) / letters fly in one at a time
